title: echoes VIP
description: echoes is a Vertically Integrated Project at RIT. I am a web developer, meaning I help add new features to their website and help fix bugs as they come up. I work part time for course credit and can work on whatever part of the website I want to. This past semester, I created their brand guide, a page to show off current opportunities in the project, helped implement images into their game pages, and updated the web documentation.
skillsList: Svelte, Tailwind CSS, JS, Vite, NodeJS, Agile Methodology

title: Portfolio Website
description: This site was created as a project to help me teach myself how to use React and style websites better. I built the entire thing from scratch using react with vite and javascript. Eventually, I hope to add a Games section to show off more personal projects made in react.

title: WITR Library Project
description: RIT's radio station, WITR 89.7, has the second largest privately owned CD and Vinyl collection in the state of New York. The Library Project aims to organize and label all of our CDs. As Librarian, I am in charge of cataloging every CD into our own database, as well as being one of two people involved in leading a team of volunteers organizing this collection.
